lines.t: Pulled up, draped in glory, no ice, just light when He slide on the scene
Voice like many waters when He talk that talk, split seas, make a real G lean
King Eternal, crowns on crowns, got a throne they can’t overthrow
He the Rock, break idols like dust, one word, whole empire let go
Opps set traps but the Lamb don’t lose, Lion move slow, yet He crush that line
Blood on the lintel, Passover wave, death see the mark, gotta stay in line
He tread winepress, stain His robe, still mercy drip heavy on those who repent
Make the proud fall flat, lift the low from the dirt, put the broke in the King’s tent
Crown on high, throne made of flames, He ride slow through the stars so clean
Sovereign name on the gates of time, whole realm bow down to the unseen King
Every knee drop low when He swing that sword, all opps gon’ know what “Lord” really mean
Boss of all bosses, fire in His eyes, YAHUWAH reign, YahuShua run the whole team
Top down, clouds split, King step out, whole block go still, no sound
Foot hit earth, mountains shake, all fake thrones get thrown to the ground
He the Ladder, He the Gate, He the Way, can’t move ‘less He say “proceed”
Talk bout “goat”, He the Lamb and the Lion, one roar make a whole war bleed
Every opp tongue talk tough right now, but the books gon’ open, case closed
Names in the scroll or the ash in the wind, that smoke when the last trump blow
He the Kingdom, Power, Glory, no cap, no vote, no term, no end
Boss of all bosses, King of all kings, every hater gon’ bow in the end
Crown on high, throne made of flames, He ride slow through the stars so clean
Sovereign name on the gates of time, whole realm bow down to the unseen King
Every knee drop low when He swing that sword, all opps gon’ know what “Lord” really mean
Boss of all bosses, fire in His eyes, YAHUWAH reign, YahuShua run the whole team[OUTRO - CHOPPED & SCREWED DESCRIPTION]
